title: Bar Drop Cherry Cola 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Cherry Cola by Drop is a classic beverage-inspired flavour with a fruity twist. It captures the distinct, caramelised sweetness and subtle spice of vintage cola on the inhale. This familiar base is enriched by a burst of dark, ripe cherry, adding a fruity depth that complements the fizzy soda sensation on the exhale. Formulated with a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, this blend ensures the complex spice notes of the cola and the sweetness of the cherry are delivered with high-definition clarity. Perfect for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vaping, it offers a smooth throat hit via its nicotine salt formula, available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Bar Drop Salts is a range of nic salt e-liquids from UK manufacturer, Drop, that specialises in creating fruity flavours of astonishing authenticity and clarity.
